raw_segments.text: "'I done what I could to keep you and tickler in sunders, but my power were not always fully
For when your poor sister had a mind to drop into you, it were not so much,' said Joe,
in his favorite argumentative way, "'that she dropped into me too if I put myself in
opposition to her, but that she dropped into you always heavier for it.'
"'It ain't a grab at a man's whisker, not yet a shake or two of a man, to which
your sister was quite welcome, that I'd put a man off from getting a little child out
But when that little child is dropped into heavier for that grab of whisker or shaking,
then that man natterily up and says to himself, "'Where is the good as you are a-doing?'
"'I grant you I see the arm,' says the man, "'but I don't see the good.
I call upon you, sir, therefore, to pine out the good.'"
